description: Analyze solar azimuth, day/night terminator crossings, aurora borealis/australis probability, and time zone shift along a flight path to recommend the best scenic and glare-free window seat (left vs right side).

aircraft.description: Optional aircraft profile ID, alias, or name among 15 profiles for cruise speed duration scaling.

departure_preset.description: Departure time preset for solar modeling. Defaults to morning.

include_samples.description: Optional flag to include the 25-point trajectory solar sample array in structuredContent. Defaults to false for compact responses.

name: recommend_window_seat
